skill.description: Generate structured songs, instrumentals, jingles, and loops with ElevenLabs Music through the RunComfy CLI. Control duration, style, lyrics, song sections, vocals, and output format.

security_audit.summary: All 59 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, documentation links, and a documented protected token path. The skill legitimately invokes a third-party service, and prompts or lyrics are transmitted to RunComfy for processing. Publication should disclose this data transfer and advise users to avoid confidential material.

remediation.issue: Prompts and lyrics are sent to an external model service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the transfer before invocation and advise users not to submit confidential, regulated, or unreleased material without authorization.

content.user_title: Generate Music with ElevenLabs on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Creating structured music from text often requires specialized audio tools and manual setup. This skill guides RunComfy CLI requests for songs, instrumentals, jingles, and loops.
actual_capabilities: Generates 5-second to 5-minute stereo music through the ElevenLabs Music endpoint.
Combines genre, mood, tempo, instruments, vocals, and structured lyrics in one prompt.
Creates vocal songs or instrumental tracks using the force_instrumental option.
Supports section markers such as Intro, Verse, Chorus, Bridge, and Outro.
Downloads generated MP3 or supported WAV output through the RunComfy CLI.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, network access, authentication, and sufficient account credits.
Each request supports 5 seconds to 5 minutes of audio.
Voice selection, voice cloning, sound effects, and text-to-speech are outside this endpoint.
Results can vary, and longer generations cost more than short drafts.

use_cases.title: Score a short video
use_cases.description: Create a timed theme with structured sections, vocals, or instrumental accompaniment for an edited video.

use_cases.title: Build podcast branding
use_cases.description: Generate a brief instrumental intro or outro with a clear ending and consistent sonic identity.

use_cases.title: Create a game loop
use_cases.description: Produce steady instrumental background music with loop-friendly pacing for a game scene.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 30-second instrumental with a calm mood, 80 BPM, warm piano, soft drums, no vocals, and MP3 output.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a short background track.

prompt_templates.title: Make a podcast intro
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second podcast intro with bright marimba, light percussion, a clean ending, no vocals, and a concise professional tone.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a polished audio identity for a podcast.

prompt_templates.title: Structure a vocal song
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 60-second indie-pop song at 120 BPM with female vocals, using [Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], and [Outro] around these lyrics: {lyrics}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Control song structure and vocal delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a multilingual release
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce matching 45-second versions in {languages}; preserve tempo, instrumentation, section timing, and meaning while changing only the language-specific lyrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate one coordinated call for each language.

output_examples.input: A 30-second lo-fi instrumental at 75 BPM for studying.
output_examples.output: A downloaded 44.1 kHz stereo MP3 with warm piano, restrained drums, a stable groove, and no vocals.

output_examples.input: A one-minute indie-pop song with supplied verse and chorus lyrics.
output_examples.output: A structured vocal track with an intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro, and the requested instrumentation.

output_examples.input: A five-second cheerful brand stinger with no vocals.
output_examples.output: A short instrumental audio file with bright marimba and a clear final chord.

best_practices: Start with a 30 to 45 second draft before generating a longer final track.
Specify one coherent genre, mood, tempo, instrument set, and vocal direction per request.
Confirm lyric rights and remove confidential material before sending a prompt.
anti_patterns: Do not combine conflicting genres or moods in one request.
Do not use this endpoint for sound effects, speech synthesis, or voice cloning.
Do not place API tokens, private data, or unauthorized lyrics in the prompt.

faq.question: What do I need before generation?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI, sign in, provide network access, and ensure the account has sufficient credits.

faq.question: How long can a track be?
faq.answer: Each request can generate between 5 seconds and 5 minutes of audio.

faq.question: Can it create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Enable force_instrumental and state that the prompt requires no vocals.

faq.question: Can it generate multilingual vocals?
faq.answer: Yes. Write lyrics in the target language and create one request for each language version.

faq.question: Does generation have a cost?
faq.answer: Yes. Pricing scales with duration, so short drafts reduce iteration costs.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads the generated audio into the selected output directory.
